summary: Design agent completed Low-Level Design for FR-BRICK-004 (Issue #15) — Support brick rotation in 90-degree increments around the vertical axis. LLD covers: BrickRotation enum (0/90/180/270) in types/brick.ts, PlacedBrick.rotation field, RotateBrick command (execute/undo with captured previousRotation), getRotatedFootprint() in gridMath.ts (swaps studsX/studsZ at 90/270 degrees), uiStore.previewRotation (ephemeral, not undoable), sceneStore.rotateBrick() (atomic release+update+occupy), occupancyMap rotated footprint integration, useKeyboardShortcuts R key binding (place mode vs select mode), BrickMesh/GhostBrick Three.js rotation via (deg * PI) / 180, 4 sequence diagrams (preview rotate, placed brick rotate, undo, placement with rotated preview), error handling (unknown brickId early return, enum type safety, atomic occupancy), security considerations, performance budget (< 16 ms keypress-to-render), test case mapping (T-BE-BRICK-004-01, T-BE-BRICK-004-02, T-E2E-BRICK-004-01), and 6 open questions. Draft PR #64 is open on branch feature/15-fr-brick-004-design awaiting Gate 6a human design review before merge to main. Area determined as frontend (pure client-side SPA).
